messages:
Priya Desai: Quick proposal: run a 6-week pilot for a 7-day postmortem follow-up flow (we're calling them \"sprintlets\"). aim: reduce action drift and make owners accountable.
Tom Nguyen: curious what the cadence looks like. do you mean a hard 7-day SLA per action?
Priya Desai: yes for most low-complexity actions. large items can be flagged as \"epic\" and get a 2-week window + check-ins. goal is to avoid things sitting in limbo.
Alex Chen: +1. suggest a small timeline template so people know expectations: Day0 create ticket, Day2 triage, Day3 plan, Day7 implement/verify/close or escalate.
Maria Gomez: communicate roles clearly: incident commander (handles incident comms), remediation owner (owns the action), verification owner (verifies fix), and escalation contact. IC should assign remediation owner before incident channel unlock.
Tom Nguyen: what about rotation? IC rotation stays weekly. remediation owner rotation could be per-sprintlet or a 2-week pool to avoid churn.
Priya Desai: propose: IC weekly rotation (no change), remediation owner assigned per action but teams maintain a 2-week on-call rota for remediation duty. keeps ownership local.
oncall-bot: Automation idea: add label \"sprintlet-7d\" when action is created. auto-reminder on Day4 and Day6. escalate Day8 if not closed.
Alex Chen: suggested ticket schema (short):
```
Follow-up ticket fields:
- incident: INC-XXXX
- owner: <name>
- verification_owner: <name>
- complexity: small/medium/epic
- due_date: YYYY-MM-DD
- slo-impact: explanation (latency/cost/availability)
- recurrence_flag: none/possible/likely
- status: triage/in-progress/blocked/done
- monitoring_window: 30/90 days
- notes: links to PRs/runbooks/metrics
```
Maria Gomez: add a field for \"rollback plan\" and \"post-close monitoring metrics\" pls. also require a 1-line status in ticket at the weekly pulse.
Priya Desai: good call. We should also track a \"recurrence_reason\" tag so we can aggregate patterns across incidents.
Tom Nguyen: templates and dashboards pls. dashboard should show % closed in 7d, average time-to-close, and recurrence-alerts by service.
Alex Chen: I can mock a Grafana widget and a small JQL filter. will attach before pilot.
Maria Gomez: pilot scope: infra, runtime, platform. metrics to measure: 7-day close rate, owner-update compliance, recurrence at 30/60/90.
Priya Desai: rollout plan: week 0 - doc and signup; weeks 1-6 - pilot; week 7 - analyze & recommend. who will coordinate signups?
Tom Nguyen: I can run infra side and help with dashboards. Maria you ok to coordinate runtime + platform?
Maria Gomez: yup, I can.
Priya Desai: I'll draft the short playbook + timeline template and post signup form in #eng-oncall by EOD tomorrow. Pilot volunteers: please DM me. :raised_hands:
Alex Chen: last nit: require a 1-line summary in incident channel when remediation owner assigned, so SRE/PMs know.
Priya Desai: agreed. Also adding quarterly recurrence review for items flagged \"likely\" recurrence.
oncall-bot: Created reminder rule draft: label: sprintlet-7d, reminders: day4/day6, escalate day8. review in playbook.
Priya Desai: thanks everyone. I'll post the playbook + sample ticket and dashboard links in this thread when ready.
Maria Gomez: excited to try it. small experiments FTW. :sparkles:
